verdict.rationale: The products page promises "Transparent fees" and "Flat, scoped pricing with what's included – clearly," and contrasts its "All-inclusive" approach with billable hours and add-ons, so a flat-fee model is claimed. However, no actual dollar amounts or priced service menu appear anywhere in the evidence. That means a founder cannot be shown to see real prices without first contacting the firm. missing for 10: published dollar figures per visa type, a priced service menu, any evidence that prices are visible without a consultation, independent corroboration of the fee levels.
